hypothese.summary: Thèse de croissance rentable post-scission JS Global : accélération internationale et innovation produit soutiennent une expansion structurelle de marge, avec un premier retour de capital (buyback 750M$) qui inverse le désendettement.
hypothese.text:
== THESIS SUMMARY ==
Post-spin profitable-growth story: since separating from JS Global (July 2023), 12 consecutive quarters of double-digit organic growth on a product-innovation engine (Ninja Luxe Cafe, Ninja Crispi, Shark PowerDetect) and accelerating international expansion (+31.6% in Q1 26), with the Europe/Mexico shift from distributor to direct sales completing by end-Q2 26. The bet: innovation cadence sustains growth while direct-sales mix and supply-chain diversification (out of China) defend margin through the tariff era.

== THESIS READ ==
- The innovation cadence is the moat - each new category (coffee, outdoor, beauty) extends the S-curve. Watch: new-category revenue disclosures.
- Direct-sales transition lifts gross margin but adds opex first - the 2026 print will be mix-noisy. Watch: international margin once the transition completes.
- Tariff exposure is managed via supply-chain shift - execution risk, not thesis risk. Watch: gross-margin bridge quarter by quarter.

== SPECIAL FACTORS ==
Young fiche (created 15/07/2026): dernierCall and guidanceHistory ABSENT by construction - to initialize at the next quarterly report; priorEPS null. 'data' retreated for two true separation one-offs (2022: 34M discretionary bonus; 2023: 82.3M separation costs + 19.5M withholding tax), published figures kept in-fiche for audit traceability. Consensus basis wedge documented (adjusted street vs retreated GAAP).

== PARAMETERS & WATCH-LIST ==
2026: revenue 7,167M (+12%), EBIT 1,061M (14.8%), EPS 5.51; 2027-2030: revenue +8%/yr fading, margin ~15-15.8%, ETR 22% (company's own normalized rate), shares -1%/yr, net debt low and stable. Watch: next report (dernierCall init + first guidance archive); US consumer discretionary demand; tariff-regime changes.

== CATALYSTS ==
Next quarterly report (initializes the guidance archive); holiday-season sell-through; new-category launches; international direct-sales margin proof.

ancrages.mechanism: Guidance FY2026 relevee au T1'26 : CA +11,5% a +12,5%, midpoint 12,0% retenu
Deceleration progressive 10%->6%, coherente avec la maturation post-hypercroissance et la croissance revenu consensus ~9,6%/an sur 3 ans (Simply Wall St)
Expansion de la marge EBIT GAAP de +40 a +50pb/an, coherente avec le levier operationnel guide sur l'Adjusted EBITDA (+32pb en 2026), moderee par les pressions tarifaires
Taux d'IS GAAP maintenu a 22,5% (milieu de la guidance 22%-23%), coherent avec les exercices 2024-2025
omniumNet reintegre la SBC et l'amortissement des intangibles d'acquisition, exclus par l'Adjusted EPS du management (ecart ~0,50-0,55$/action vs consensus non-GAAP)
Programme de rachat d'actions de 750M$ autorise fev.2026, demarre au T1'26 (deja +117M$ de dette nette sur le trimestre) ; inverse la tendance de desendettement 2023-2025

Correction des couts de transaction lies a la separation JS Global (2023 : 82,3M$ pretax), de la retenue a la source sur le dividende special (2023 : 19,5M$) et du bonus discretionnaire exceptionnel (2022 : 34,0M$ pretax) ; IS normalise a 22% sur les additions pretax
